CustomField.label: Installment Percentage
CustomField.description: For an installment component of a payment plan bundle (e.g. WS Payment Plan), the percentage of the selected payment plan's own price this installment represents (e.g. 30 for 30%). Read by RES_ResidentialBundlePricingHook to compute the installment's display amount, and by RES_Contract_AfterSave_Generate_Installment_CIP to build the Installment Contract Item Price rows. Informational only - never fed back into pricing.
